Mexilex lexical data snapshot lex-v0.1.0

Publication intent: create the first permanent versioned data release from this
main-branch Git commit. This is the single-use release trigger; it is NOT a
generic auto-release for future commits.

Includes:
- A generated SQLite database reconstructed from the 813,928-entry Git corpus
- Stateless es-MX vocabulary records defined in English
- Explicit Mexico-labeled meanings as a separate study subset
- Mexican film-dialogue frequency sidecar with independent GPL-2.0 terms
- Source revision, attribution, licenses and SHA-256 checksums

Build and validation are performed by .github/workflows/release.yml. If any
test, source check, archive check or upload fails, do not claim publication.
No SRS reviews, personal progress, or learner data belong in these archives.
